Which one of the following statements is incorrect regarding the Andhra Mahasabha?
o: It was founded in 1930 at Jogipet.
Madapati Hanumantha Rao was its first President.
It played a significant role in spreading education and political awareness among the people of Telangana.
It was established primarily to support the policies of the Nizam Government.
x:
The Andhra Mahasabha was founded in 1930 at Jogipet (Medak district) with the objective of promoting the social, educational and cultural advancement of Telugu-speaking people in the Hyderabad State. The first session was presided over by Madapati Hanumantha Rao, who is popularly known as the "Andhra Pitamaha." Initially, the organisation concentrated on social reforms, promotion of the Telugu language and expansion of education. Gradually, it developed into an important political platform that opposed the autocratic rule of the Nizam and spread political consciousness among the people of Telangana. During the 1940s, many of its leaders became associated with the peasant movement against feudal oppression. Therefore, the statement that it was established to support the policies of the Nizam Government is incorrect. Hence, the correct answer is Option (4).
Exam Note:
• Founded – 1930
• Place – Jogipet (Medak)
• First President – Madapati Hanumantha Rao
• Objective – Social reform, education and political awareness among Telugu people of Hyderabad State

x: On 16 August, 1932 A.D., Ramsay Macdonald announced his Communal Award. The award authorised Indian Christians, Muslims, Europeans, Sikhs, Depressed Classes and others to have separate electorates. Gandhi began fast unto death on 20th September, 1932 A.D. to protest against this decision. Finally, on 24 September, 1932 A.D. an agreement was made in Poona known as ‘Poona Pact’ in which joint electorate was accepted on the basis of two provisions. The two provisions were – Firstly, there were 148 seats reserved for depressed classes in the provincial legislature while only 71 seats were reserved according to communal award. In Central Legislature 18 percent of the seats allotted to the general electorate were reserved for depressed classes. So reason (R) explains assertion (A) correctly, and both statements are true. So, the option (a) is correct answer.
